description: Source code for the 'Setting' model class in Opencart, handling CRUD operations for store settings in the database.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Model class for managing store settings in Opencart, including retrieving, editing, and deleting settings.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a given store ID, including default store settings.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves specific settings by code and store ID, decoding serialized data if necessary.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Updates settings for a given code and store ID, inserting new entries or updating existing ones.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes settings for a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Deletes all settings associated with a specific code across all stores.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all settings for a specific store ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific setting key for a store, decoding JSON if serialized.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Updates the value of a specific setting key for a store, encoding as JSON if necessary.
